meta.vintage: Calendar year 2025: BTS T-100 Segment (all carriers) and BTS On-Time Reporting Carrier data; OurAirports reference; U.S. Census geography. Retrieved 2026-10-18.

coverage.denominator: all US-origin scheduled passenger enplanements in T-100 (incl. territories and international departures)

census_geocoder.table: Geographies by coordinates (benchmark Public_AR_Current, vintage Current_Current)

annual_passengers.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0
annual_passengers.note: enplaned passengers, domestic + international, all carriers

international_passenger_share.formula: 1 - passengers on segments with DEST_COUNTRY=US / all passengers (territories count as US)
international_passenger_share.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0

annual_departures.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0

pax_growth_yoy.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0

load_factor.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0
load_factor.note: seat fill on departing segments (not BTS passenger-miles LoadFactor); null under 365 departures

haul_mix.formula: share of DEPARTURES_PERFORMED by DISTANCE: short <1100 mi, long >2200 mi, medium between
haul_mix.filter: T-100 Segment (All Carriers), CLASS=F (scheduled passenger/cargo), AIRCRAFT_CONFIG<>2 (not freight config), ORIGIN_COUNTRY=US, DEPARTURES_PERFORMED>0

avg_dep_delay_min.formula: AVG(DepDelayMinutes) over non-cancelled departures with a delay value
avg_dep_delay_min.note: On-Time Reporting Carrier, origin airport, CY2025; null if fewer than 5000 scheduled departures

delayed_share.formula: SUM(DepDel15=1) / non-cancelled departures with a delay value
delayed_share.note: On-Time Reporting Carrier, origin airport, CY2025; null if fewer than 5000 scheduled departures

cancel_rate.note: On-Time Reporting Carrier, origin airport, CY2025; null if fewer than 5000 scheduled departures

name,city,state,lat,lon,icao.formula: OurAirports airports.csv, matched on iata_code, iso_country=US

runways.formula: count of runways with closed<>1, excluding helipads (le_ident H*)
runways.note: runways_legacy_count keeps the old all-rows count for comparison

bts_city_market_id,bts_city_name.formula: ORIGIN_CITY_MARKET_ID, ORIGIN_CITY_NAME as reported by BTS

cbsa_*,csa_*,county_*.formula: point-in-polygon of airport lat/lon: Metropolitan (else Micropolitan) Statistical Area, Combined Statistical Area, County; null where the point is outside that layer

not_sourced: Delay causes and taxi-out time are available in On-Time but not aggregated in this pass.
